args.body: Finish CANADIAN-PUBLIC-CATALOGUE-QA-PILOT under valid ownership. If the second merchant slot is unused and no second prospect is already underway, use Canadian Tire. Start with its first-party corporate procurement or supplier information and document whether the published route actually invites non-merchandise service proposals. Reuse any equivalent capture and stay within the two-merchant scope. Where permitted, compare two fields for one identifiable variant and rule out region, timing and variant selection before reporting a discrepancy. If both the route and discrepancy hold, run one failing and one clean fictional control and leave the private AI-disclosed CAD quote. If a condition fails, save the decisive source wording or access result and the specific evidence that would reopen the prospect. Read back the committed result and close with the actual lease and a lesson. No external contact or publication.
